hook: Altera claims its new chips do 1.8 times more work per watt.
sections: Agilex 2X is a family of FPGA chips, led by Agilex 27.
Think of a sports hall. Repaint the lines and it is a basketball court today, badminton tomorrow.
First, engineers load a new circuit layout. Second, the chip runs that job until they reload it.
Before, the previous generation used more power for the same work.
Now Altera claims 1.8 times performance per watt for AI, networking and edge.
Vendor-claimed, and Altera is private. Telecom equipment makers could gain. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
